near_copies.reason: The dad-joke fetcher. Date guards it on `#joke-string` while pulterit runs it on every page, so the two copies differ in behaviour and not only in layout. Unifying them is a behaviour change and needs its own decision.

The Pulterit arsfest page is still a copy of DaTe's, and biocum's is a third rewrite. `templates/common/events/arsfest_base.html` is the shared page and sf already extends it; moving date, pulterit and biocum onto it changes what visitors see, so it belongs in its own change.
